description: This file defines React components and context providers for managing routing form actions, including creating, duplicating, editing, deleting, and toggling forms within a web application. It includes UI components like dialogs, dropdowns, buttons, and switch toggles, as well as logic for handling form actions and interactions with backend APIs via trpc.

classes.name: FormActionsProvider
classes.description: React component providing context and managing state for form actions, including delete and toggle operations, with nested dialogs and mutation handling.

classes.name: FormAction
classes.description: React component representing a button or control for a specific form action (e.g., edit, delete, duplicate, toggle) with support for dropdown integration.

classes.name: NewFormDialog
classes.description: React component rendering a dialog for creating or duplicating a routing form, with form handling and mutation logic.

classes.name: Dialogs
classes.description: Component managing delete confirmation dialog and embedding routing form dialog, coordinating delete mutations and dialog states.

classes.name: FormActionsDropdown
classes.description: Component providing a dropdown menu for form actions, wrapping children with dropdown trigger and menu content.

methods.name: useRouter
methods.description: Hook to access Next.js router for navigation.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates React context for sharing state across components.

methods.name: forwardRef
methods.description: Higher-order component to forward refs to child components.

methods.name: useState
methods.description: React hook for managing component state.

methods.name: useForm
methods.description: Hook from react-hook-form for managing form state.

methods.name: uuidv4
methods.description: Function to generate a UUID v4 string.

methods.name: getFieldIdentifier
methods.description: Utility to get unique identifier for form fields.

methods.description: Serializes query parameters for data table filters.

methods.name: useOrgBranding
methods.description: Hook to access organization branding info.

methods.name: RoutingFormEmbedButton
methods.description: Component for embedding routing form button.

methods.name: RoutingFormEmbedDialog
methods.description: Component for embedding routing form dialog.

methods.name: trpc.useUtils
methods.description: Hook to access tRPC utilities for data fetching and cache invalidation.
